LESSON: PRANAYAM

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Yoga
Topic 5.1: Pranayam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Pranayam. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. practice correct breathing to enhance concentration
2. appreciate the importance of correct breathing technique. 5.2 Body Postures (Asanas) good health (6 Lessons) 108 with correct breathing to improve blood circulation in the body
3. appreciate the asanaas for gaining flexibility for healthy physical growth. stretching movements with ease and perfection.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. practice correct breathing to enhance concentration
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to practice correct breathing to enhance concentration. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the importance of correct breathing technique. 5.2 Body Postures (Asanas) good health (6 Lessons) 108 with correct breathing to improve blood circulation in the body
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of correct breathing technique. 5.2 Body Postures (Asanas) good health (6 Lessons) 108 with correct breathing to improve blood circulation in the body. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the asanaas for gaining flexibility for healthy physical growth. stretching movements with ease and perfection.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the asanaas for gaining flexibility for healthy physical growth. stretching movements with ease and perfection. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Pranayam.
2. Explain Pranayam to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Pranayam.
4. Show that you can: practice correct breathing to enhance concentration
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pranayam. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Pranayam important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. practice correct breathing to enhance concentration
2. appreciate the importance of correct breathing technique. 5.2 Body Postures (Asanas) good health (6 Lessons) 108 with correct breathing to improve blood circulation in the body
3. appreciate the asanaas for gaining flexibility for healthy physical growth. stretching movements with ease and perfection.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
